title: Evaluation at a successor layer
statement: Let $F$ be a layered circuit over an alphabet $\alpha$, with input type $\mathrm{inp}$ and output type $\mathrm{out}$. For a natural number $m$ with $m+1\leq\mathrm{depth}(F)$, a node $u$ at layer $m+1$, and an input assignment $xs:\mathrm{inp}\to\alpha$, the value of $u$ is the value computed by its gate from the values of its input nodes at layer $m$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit with the stated alphabet, input type, and output type
